original_ocr_locator: Original OCR spans PDF pp.113–114, printed pp.112–113: Abyssinians spear-play commentary, Eid heading and Aisha/two-girls narration, then continuation and doll-play heading. Recovery selects only the Aisha/Eid narration on PDF p.113, printed p.112. The book attributes it to الصحيحين without printing its number beside this passage; Bukhari 952 and Muslim 892 are independent canonical matches.
excerpt:
عن عائشة قالت: «دخل علي أبو بكر وعندي جاريتان من جواري الأنصار تغنيان، بما تقاولت به الأنصار يوم بعاث».
قال رسول الله ﷺ: «يا أبا بكر إن لكل قوم عيدا وهذا عيدنا».
method: Direct visual reading of the exact primary PDF pages; raw OCR used only to locate original passages. Selected short excerpts are manually transcribed without vowel marks/line wraps; honorific glyphs expanded. No full PDF or page copy added to the repository.
